groups.title: Understanding Multi-Cloud Drivers
groups.question: Explain why an organization would choose to run on more than one cloud provider, and when it should not.

followUps.Vendor Lock-in Risk Analysis: How would you decide which workloads carry the most lock-in risk and deserve portability work first?
followUps.Poly-Cloud vs Multi-Cloud vs Hybrid: How do poly-cloud, multi-cloud and hybrid cloud differ, and what goes wrong when a team picks the wrong one?

groups.title: Cloud Provider Comparison
groups.question: Walk through how you would compare the major cloud providers before designing a workload that runs on several of them.

followUps.Service Equivalency Matrix Across AWS, A: Why is it risky to assume that equivalent services on AWS, Azure and GCP behave the same way?
followUps.Multi-Cloud Cost and Complexity Trade-of: Where do the hidden costs of multi-cloud come from, and how would you decide a workload should stay on one cloud?

groups.title: Strategy Frameworks
groups.question: Explain how you would set up a repeatable way for teams to pick a cloud provider for new work.

followUps.Building a Multi-Cloud Decision Matrix: What criteria would you put in a cloud decision matrix, and why does writing it down speed teams up?
followUps.Regulatory and Data Sovereignty Consider: How would you design data pipelines so that regulated data never leaves the regions where it is allowed to live?

groups.title: Organizational Readiness
groups.question: Explain what an engineering organization needs, beyond technology, to run multi-cloud well.

followUps.Building Multi-Cloud Competency in Teams: Why does multi-cloud often turn into separate single-cloud silos, and how would you prevent that?
followUps.Establishing a Cloud Center of Excellenc: What does a Cloud Center of Excellence own, and what happens to a multi-cloud estate without one?
